title.zh-TW: 報表圖表直接標記結論，改用直覺長條與每週趨勢圖
title.en: Report charts directly state conclusions, switching to intuitive bars and weekly trend charts

body.zh-TW: 當你打開用量報表想快速掌握整體的呼叫狀況時，不再需要對著複雜圖表逐項心算。⟦有如收到整頓後的健檢摘要，以前整頁只印滿密密麻麻的化驗數字，得逐項翻找對照標準；現在每區頂端直接印出重點結論，各項指標也縮成清楚的進度條。⟧現在報表每一區的標題會直接寫出結論，例如「Claude Code 以 66% 的 token 領先」，圖下並附上副標題與資料來源。這裡的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成現在改成一條堆疊長條。工具、專案與快取（將運算結果暫存供後續取用）命中率，則全數換成 0 到 100% 刻度的細長條。每週清單也改成直條圖，並替你標出最忙碌與最近一個完整週。
body.en: When you open the usage report to quickly grasp your overall call activity, you no longer need to perform mental calculations item by item over complex charts. ⟦Picture receiving a reorganized health checkup summary: where full pages were once packed with dense lab numbers requiring line-by-line checks against reference standards, key conclusions are now printed right at the top of each section, with individual metrics condensed into clear progress bars.⟧ Section titles across each area of the report now state their conclusion directly, such as "Claude Code leads with 66% of tokens", with a subtitle and data source line beneath the chart. Here, token (the text units AI processes and bills) composition has been changed into a single stacked bar. Tools, projects, and cache hit rates have all been switched to thin bars on a 0 to 100% scale. The weekly list is also turned into a column chart, marking the busiest and latest complete weeks for you.

items.original: **Report charts now state their conclusion.** Each section title says what the data shows, such as "Claude Code leads with 66% of tokens", with a subtitle and source line under the chart. Tools, projects and cache hit rate become thin bars on a 0-100% axis, token composition is one stacked bar, and the weekly list becomes a column chart that marks the busiest and latest complete weeks.

title.zh-TW: 使用習慣分析保留一小時，累積大量紀錄開報表不卡頓
title.en: Usage habit analysis is kept for an hour, opening reports without jank on heavy history

body.zh-TW: 累積了大量歷史紀錄的使用者，以往每次開啟用量報表往往需要耗費時間等待重新載入。⟦跟常客走進熟識的咖啡館一樣，櫃檯直接調出你常點的喜好清單，不必每次重新翻閱歷來點單；至於收銀機上的當日銷額與即時牌價，則隨時都在同步刷新。⟧現在使用習慣區的分析結果改為保留一小時，不再像過去每五分鐘就必須重新計算。這讓多數開啟報表的時刻，可以直接略過重新掃描所有工作階段（session，單次交談歷程）檔案的流程。所有用量數據與圖表依然維持即時更新，不會因為分析結果保留而延遲呈現。
body.en: For users who have accumulated heavy historical records, opening the usage report in the past often required spending time waiting for reloads. ⟦Just like a regular customer walking into a familiar cafe, the counter brings up your frequent preferences directly without flipping through past orders each time; meanwhile, daily sales and real-time prices on the cash register stay synchronized and refreshed at all times.⟧ Analysis results in the usage habits section are now retained for an hour instead of being recalculated every five minutes as in the past. This allows most report opens to directly skip the process of rescanning all session (a single conversation history) files. All usage numbers and charts continue to update in real time without being delayed by retaining the analysis results.

items.original: **The report opens faster on heavy history.** The usage-habits section keeps its profile for an hour instead of five minutes, so most report opens skip rescanning every session file. Usage numbers and charts stay live.

title.zh-TW: 修復額度恢復倒數、重置顯示與 Claude 視窗排程
title.en: Fix quota recovery countdowns, reset displays, and Claude window scheduling

body.zh-TW:
仰賴用量工具掌握模型配額的讀者，在額度耗盡或重置時能重新獲得即時狀態。

選單列已恢復顯示 Antigravity 額度的恢復倒數。當額度用完時會顯示距離恢復的剩餘時間，並維持短間隔更新頻率。

自 0.34.10 起，Claude Code 在 5 小時視窗過期後便不再回報，導致自動啟動無法偵測過期而停擺。現在工具會記住上次看到的重置時間，時間一過就照常開啟下一個視窗；沒有 5 小時額度的方案不受影響。

同樣從 0.34.10 起出現的顯示問題，也讓 5 小時與每週列在重置後顯示 `--`，額度恢復通知更被延至下一則回覆才發出。現在 hook（特定事件發生時自動觸發的小程式）會多保留過期視窗一整個週期，讓讀取端照常顯示 0% 與已重置，並在重置時立即送出恢復通知。沒有 5 小時額度的方案在超過一整個週期後仍會移除視窗，每週額度則持續更新。
body.en:
Readers who rely on usage tools to track model quotas can now regain real-time status when quotas are exhausted or reset.

The menu bar has restored displaying the Antigravity quota recovery countdown. When quota is used up, it shows the remaining time until recovery and maintains a short update interval.

Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stopped reporting the 5-hour window once it expired, causing auto-open to fail to detect the expiration and stall. The tool now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window as usual once that time passes; plans without a 5-hour quota are unaffected.

A display issue that also appeared since 0.34.10 caused the 5-hour and weekly rows to show `--` after a reset, while quota recovery notifications were delayed until the next reply was sent. Now the hook (a small program automatically triggered by specific events) retains expired windows for one full cycle, allowing readers to display 0% and reset status as usual, and immediately sends recovery notifications upon reset. Plans without a 5-hour quota still remove the window after more than a full cycle, while weekly quotas continue to update.

items.original:
**The menu bar shows the Antigravity recovery countdown again.** When quota is used up, it shows the time left until recovery and keeps refreshing at the short polling interval.
**Auto-open the next Claude window works again.** Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stops reporting the 5-hour window once it expires, so the keeper never saw it expire and never opened the next one. It now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window after it passes. Plans without a 5-hour limit are unaffected.
**Reset Claude quota rows and recovery notifications work again.** Since 0.34.10, the 5-hour and weekly rows showed `--` after a reset, and quota-restored notifications waited until the next Claude reply. The hook now keeps each expired window for one full cycle so readers show 0% and the reset message, and recovery notifications arrive at reset. Plans without a 5-hour limit still drop that window after a full cycle; weekly updates keep working.
